versions.changelog:
coppa-guard v1.0.0 – initial release

- Real-time detection of 6 categories of COPPA-triggering/violating terms in drafts for US children’s products (apps, games, e-commerce, education).
- Automatic risk grading (high/medium/low) with actionable remediation advice per finding.
- Deduplicates overlapping hits to reduce false positives and outputs results in structured JSON for agent integration.
- Purely local, zero network requests, zero dynamic code execution; Python standard library only.
- Detection rules are centralized in a single file for easy updates and transparent auditing.
- Comprehensive compliance and usage disclaimers included; MIT license.
